mechanics.definition: Wild在实际结算时替代声明允许的结算符号，并按明确优先级参与中奖组合。

conditional_packages.when: Wild对象跨后续步骤或旋转保留或移动，且persistence_state_id引用活动position_set持久状态
linked_multiplier_id指向活动倍率节点，且存在专属wild_multiplier_dependency_evidence并与倍率共享同一结算事件集

evidence_signatures: settlement records identify a Wild as an actual substitute in a paid result
the paid result changes when the Wild substitution rule is applied
exclusions: a symbol only looks like Wild but never substitutes
source cells are converted into another symbol before settlement
ordinary symbols share artwork without substitution semantics

mechanics.definition: 合格Wild按明确几何与时点规则覆盖或生成额外Wild位置，扩展结果随后参与盘面或结算。

conditional_packages.when: 扩展Wild跨后续步骤或旋转保留
扩展Wild在同一结算步骤与倍率联合生效，linked_multiplier_id指向活动倍率节点，且存在专属wild_multiplier_dependency_evidence

evidence_signatures: pre-expansion and post-expansion coordinates identify newly effective Wild cells
expansion follows the declared geometry and timing
exclusions: Wild仅以堆叠形式直接从卷轴生成
任意来源符号被转换为Wild但不存在扩展源
Wild只在结算中替代而不新增有效位置
